messages:
nina: Quick flag 10 enterprise customer reported being charged retroactive promo adjustments twice on INV-2026-1132. Overcharged by $4,125. Invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.dev/INV-2026-1132
maria: Oof. Please paste the reconciliation extract and customer's billing contact. We need to confirm whether the system applied a retroactive promo + manual adj.
sam: Reconciliation CSV snippet attached (posted in thread). billing@orbitalai.com. Looks like both EXP-RETRO-01 and MANUAL-RETRO were applied the same day.
billing-bot: Alert: Invoice INV-2026-1132 flagged promo_duplication. Case ID FIN-2026-1410. Invoice status: HOLD.
kevin: Approve one-time manual credit of $4,125 as goodwill. Charge GL 6501 and tag customer=orbitalai project=pilot-retro. Approve immediate processing.
maria: Noted. I'll create journal entry tonight. Journal: Debit Sales Discounts (GL6501) $4,125 / Credit Accounts Receivable $4,125. Memo: "Manual credit per KEVIN approval; case FIN-2026-1410."
nina: CS also asked for a $200 waiver for next month's seat fee. Is that pre-approved?
kevin: Approve the $200 waiver. Add to memo and handle as separate adjustment in next billing cycle.
sam: Posted credit. Refund txn RFT-20260509-559. Invoice note updated and ticket linked: https://billing.redwood.internal/tickets/FIN-2026-1410.
billing-bot: Case FIN-2026-1410 closed by user sam at 2026-05-09T22:30:01Z.
maria: I'll include a line in the reconciliation report for audit and mark EXP-RETRO-01 for product to prevent duplicate application.
nina: Thanks all 89.
